title: Refractor
description: Beatles covers reprinted as chrome refractor cards in penny sleeves. Tilt one and a diffraction grating splits the light into rainbow bands across the border and sky while the print stays matte ink; flick it hard and the next record swaps in at the edge-on moment of the spin.
intent: One optical material finished to the edge, now on real records: a grating equation drives the rainbow, a chrome map generated from each cover keeps the print matte, and a fast flick riffles through the albums one per turn, swapping cards while they are edge-on.
